items.exampleEn: Cats like to stretch after they wake up.
Our aim is to plant a hundred trees this year.
items.exampleZh: 我們的目標是今年種一百棵樹。

items.exampleEn: The opening of the new mall was very busy.
items.exampleZh: 新購物中心開幕時人很多。

items.exampleEn: The river flows through the city.
Don't waste water when you brush your teeth.
Don't expose the photos to strong light.
items.exampleZh: 不要讓照片暴露在強光下。

items.exampleEn: The museum shows the achievements of famous scientists.
items.exampleZh: 博物館展示著名科學家的成就。

items.exampleEn: The museum acquired an old painting last year.
items.exampleZh: 博物館去年取得了一幅古畫。

items.sentenceEn: The aim of the game is to score more points.
items.sentenceZh: 這個遊戲的目標是得到更多分。

items.audioEn: At ten, the mayor of the city will give a speech at the library's opening.
items.audioZh: 十點時，市長會在圖書館的開幕式上演講。
options: The head of the new library.
A famous writer from the city.

items.sentenceEn: Traffic flows slowly in the morning.
The shop will have its opening next week.

items.stemEn: Winning the national prize was her greatest ____.
items.stemZh: 贏得全國大獎是她最大的成就。

items.stemEn: She ____ her arm to reach the book on the top shelf.
items.stemZh: 她伸長手臂去拿書架最上層的書。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, a new sports center had its opening with a children's race. Before the race, the coach told everyone to stretch their legs. Her aim was simple: every child should enjoy the run. One boy, who was ill last year, had acquired new skills and finished the whole race. It was a great achievement for him. The local organization that planned the race did not waste any water: bottles were filled from a fountain where clean water flows all day. Some kids were exposed to strong sun, so volunteers gave out hats.
items.passageZh: 上週六，一座新的運動中心以一場兒童賽跑開幕。賽前，教練要大家先伸展雙腿。她的目標很簡單：讓每個孩子都享受跑步。有一個去年生病的男孩，學會了新的技巧，還跑完了全程，這對他來說是很大的成就。負責這場比賽的地方組織完全沒有浪費水：瓶子都在一座整天流著乾淨水的噴泉裝水。有些孩子曬到了強烈的陽光，所以志工發了帽子。

options: 讓每個孩子都享受跑步
讓她的隊伍拿下所有的獎牌
打破這座城市的比賽紀錄

items.promptZh: 他把整個週末都浪費在看電視上。
referenceEn: He wasted the whole weekend watching TV.
He wasted his whole weekend on TV.
rubricZh: waste 表示「浪費」，例如 waste time、waste the weekend 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 acquire 造一個句子，說說你最近學到或想學的一項技能。
referenceEn: I acquired some cooking skills during the holidays.
I want to acquire a new skill this year.
rubricZh: acquire 表示「取得、習得」，例如 acquire skills 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
